infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Veltai reads your active energy and steps from Apple Health to cross-check against your daily calorie goal.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Veltai can write the nutrition you log to Apple Health, only when you choose to.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Veltai uses the camera to scan your meals and food labels for accurate calorie tracking.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Veltai uses the microphone so you can describe meals by voice instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Veltai uses Face ID to keep your health data private.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Veltai uses your photo library so you can attach existing photos of meals.
